issue.title: Fix Fuzziness#asDistance(String)

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Currently Fuzziness#asDistance(String) doesn't work for custom AUTO values. If
the fuzziness is AUTO, the method returns the correct edit distance to use,
depending on the input string, but for custom AUTO values it currently always
returns an edit distance of 1. Correcting this and adding unit and integration
tests to catch these cases.

Closes #39614

body: @fadijabi thanks, I think I found the issue and opened a PR to fix this.
